_doc: Stems where human annotators would disagree about whether the item is
double-barreled. These are deliberately NOT asserted pass or fail.
Writing a pass/fail assertion over a genuinely contested reading would
freeze one arbitrary interpretation into the spec: every later improvement
to the rule would then collide with the assertion and look like a
regression, which turns the test from a guard rail into drag.
Instead the test records current behaviour against the `current_behavior`
field below. A change there is not a failure — it is a prompt to confirm
the change was intended. Drift stays visible without a contested judgement
being dressed up as an objective standard.
`current_behavior` is a snapshot, not a target. Update it deliberately.

cases.why_contested: Service and products are arguably two distinct targets, but the pair is also a common set phrase for the company as a whole.
cases.current_behavior_reason: Only 服务 is in the evaluation-object list; 产品 is not, so the both-sides requirement is not met.

stem.zh-CN: 您对我们的服务和产品满意吗？
stem.en: Are you satisfied with our service and products?

cases.why_contested: Organisation and arrangement are near synonyms here; some readers see one impression, others two.
cases.current_behavior_reason: Only 安排 is in the evaluation-object list.

stem.zh-CN: 您觉得本次活动的组织和安排如何？
stem.en: How do you feel about the organisation and arrangement of this event?

cases.why_contested: Highly correlated in practice, yet clearly separable: staff can be competent and rude.
cases.current_behavior_reason: Both 专业性 and 态度 are evaluation objects and no guard applies.

stem.zh-CN: 请评价客服人员的专业性和态度。
stem.en: Please rate the professionalism and attitude of our support staff.

cases.why_contested: The textbook example, but many practitioners treat friendly-and-helpful as one overall impression of the interaction.
cases.current_behavior_reason: Neither adjective is in the evaluation-object list, which holds nouns.

stem.zh-CN: 工作人员是否友善且乐于助人？
stem.en: Was the staff friendly and helpful?

cases.why_contested: Family and friends are two audiences a respondent may feel differently about, but the phrase is a fixed idiom in recommendation items.
cases.current_behavior_reason: The person guard fires: both sides are companions, not evaluation objects.

stem.zh-CN: 您是否愿意把本产品推荐给家人和朋友？
stem.en: Would you recommend this product to family and friends?

cases.why_contested: Environment is physical, atmosphere is social; whether respondents separate them is an empirical question, not a linguistic one.
cases.current_behavior_reason: Both 环境 and 氛围 are evaluation objects and no guard applies.

stem.zh-CN: 本店的环境和氛围让您感到舒适吗？
stem.en: Did the environment and atmosphere make you comfortable?
